title: The Pleroma Map: 8 Rungs x 3 Faces

faceNotes.Syzygy: the key cycle and its signed counts

rungs.name: Pair (Logic)
rungs.caption: Signed insertion, deletion, and bit toggle. Two copies cancel.
rungs.description: Add and remove items; toggle bits; sign-flip counts.

cells.name: Signed insertion and deletion
cells.description: 0 = (+1) + (-1): add any signed count to any key up to capacity K, remove exactly.
cells.api: Add(item, count), Remove, AddFlagWords(words, counts), Add(Pleroma), Subtract(Pleroma)
cells.evidence: Adding a count and then removing it zeroes every cell on the default field and on three primes; merge and subtraction are exact.

cells.name: Binary choice
cells.description: One of two arrangements (S_2): the store reads even and odd exact counts.
cells.evidence: Counts on the two arrangements are exact; a kernel of identity and swap applies them in one pass.

cells.name: Flag toggle via XOR
cells.description: Flip any subset of flag bits via an XOR mask.
cells.evidence: Each of 15 masks applied once equals the rebuilt toggled store; applied twice it is the identity; a kernel composed twice is the identity.

rungs.name: Identity (Sets)
rungs.caption: Lookup, one-hot categories, exact flag words at any load.
rungs.description: Key positions on a cycle; one-hot categories; binary codes.

cells.name: Key on the cycle
cells.description: A key is one position on a finite cycle: a positional code.
cells.evidence: Keys exact 30 of 30 at 16 keys; refused 30 of 30 at 17 and beyond.

cells.name: One-hot category
cells.description: One arrangement picked out of the symmetric group.
cells.evidence: The arrangement index round-trips exactly, and a one-item store reads as one-hot.

cells.name: Binary codes and Hamming retrieval
cells.description: Every flag word and its Hamming-distance neighbours.
cells.evidence: Flag counts are exact at any load; Flags(bits) equals ProjectFlags(bits).Flags() for random, permuted, empty and full bit lists; Hamming retrieval is exact.

rungs.name: Relation (Algebra)
rungs.caption: Bind: keys add, flags XOR, arrangements compose. All pairs in one pass.
rungs.description: Bind two stores (group convolution); read exact counts and shares; detect parity.

cells.name: Multiset composition via binding
cells.description: Keys add modulo the key space; counts multiply. One block product per representation.
cells.evidence: Bind equals the store of all pairs, cell for cell, 35 of 35 across five shapes (including a continuous component and self-bind). The three-face read is exact 192 of 192 on three fields.

cells.name: Arrangement composition
cells.description: Bind composes arrangements as a permutation product, with the left store on the left.
cells.evidence: Arrangement unbinding is exact 1,000 of 1,000 in the store; reversing the order changes the result in 5,800 of 10,000 cases.

cells.name: Parity: odd-occurrence XOR
cells.description: Bind XORs flags; the parity of a count is read from the sign of its cosine.
cells.evidence: Bit counts and parity are exact 12 of 12 on three fields; all 256 parity classes are exact.

rungs.name: Function (Transforms)
rungs.caption: Store as lookup table. Shifts as harmonics. Time-valued maps with the TimeSpectrum option.
rungs.description: The store as a lookup table; weighted shifts in one pass; tick histograms and maps.

cells.name: Table and Fourier shift
cells.description: The store is the harmonic transform. A one-item store bound to the store shifts every key and value at once.
cells.api: ShiftKeys(k), Bind with a one-item store, TryItems lookup
cells.evidence: Bind with a one-item store equals the whole-store shift: 20 of 20 (key shift, flag relabel, arrangement relabel and tick agree).

cells.name: Map of ticks, with balance check
cells.description: Each key maps to one tick or to a mix. The TimeSpectrum option holds each key's tick histogram.
cells.evidence: Time spectrum exact 37 of 37 (three fields, signed). One tick per key: 60 of 60. Composed maps 18 of 18, with bijections undone by their inverse.

cells.name: Boolean function and Walsh spectrum
cells.description: Fourier analysis of any Boolean predicate over the flag cube.
cells.evidence: Predicates exact 1,515 of 1,515; 1,024 of 1,024 parity functions read from one spectrum; weighted predicates 30 of 30.

rungs.name: Symmetry (Automorphisms)
rungs.caption: ScaleKeys (permute or gather). Conjugate arrangements. Frobenius squaring on GF(2).
rungs.description: Key permutation and gathering; arrangement conjugation; GF(2) bit squaring.

cells.name: Key permutation and gather
cells.description: Harmonic h goes to u h modulo N: a unit permutes, a non-unit gathers. Needs the complete key band.
cells.api: ScaleKeys(u) on CompleteKeys (key cycle N at most 4096)
cells.evidence: Every unit of 225 permutes (120 of 120 on two fields); every non-unit gathers (113 of 113).

cells.name: Conjugation of arrangements
cells.description: s goes to sigma s sigma^-1 for any permutation sigma.
cells.evidence: All 24 by 24 left and right pairs on S_4 are exact.

cells.name: GF(2) Frobenius: bit squaring
cells.description: b(x) goes to b(x) squared, modulo an irreducible polynomial. A linear map on the flag cube.
cells.evidence: Exact 18 of 18 (default field, continuous component, three primes). The eighth power is the identity on x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + 1.

rungs.name: Composition (Products, Codes)
rungs.caption: CRT pairing of key cycles. Linear bit maps. Hamming syndromes.
rungs.description: Chinese remainder pairing of key cycles; linear bit maps; Hamming codes.

cells.name: Chinese remainder theorem pairing
cells.description: Joins two coprime key cycles N_a and N_b into N_a N_b through their residues.
cells.evidence: Exact 12 of 12 (63 by 55 with a continuous component, and 9 by 25); refusals checked.

cells.name: Independence test
cells.description: Checks whether joint counts equal the product of their marginals, in exact integers.
cells.evidence: Independent stores report true 40 of 40; dependent stores false 40 of 40; one added item breaks independence 40 of 40.

cells.name: Hamming syndromes
cells.description: Counts per Hamming syndrome (3, 7 or 15 flag bits).
cells.evidence: Exact 15 of 15. All 112 single errors of Hamming(7,4) are located; all 336 double errors are sent to a wrong third position.

rungs.name: Turning (Dynamics)
rungs.caption: Tick (exact rotation). Diffuse (Markov mixing). Shift registers.
rungs.description: Time evolution by rotation and diffusion; linear recurrences over GF(2).

cells.name: Spiral on the time circle
cells.description: Rotates every item by n ticks exactly, and fades by r to the n (continuous component).
cells.evidence: All 4,096 combinations of shift, diffusion and count modulo 16 are exact.

cells.name: Diffusion: Markov mixing
cells.description: Each step, an item stays with probability a/b or moves one tick. Powers compose as kernels.
cells.evidence: Exact expected counts over 600 diffusion steps; Diffuse equals the two-element kernel.

cells.name: Shift-register cycles (Galois LFSR)
cells.description: b(x) goes to x b(x) modulo a polynomial: a linear recurrence over GF(2).
cells.evidence: Exact 9 of 9 on three primes. Period 255 for x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + 1 and 63 for x^6 + x + 1.

rungs.name: Circulation (Topology)
rungs.caption: Holonomy (winding). Current (Kolmogorov). Frustration (parity).
rungs.description: Loop holonomy (winding numbers); probability current; frustration (loop parity).

cells.name: Winding number around a loop
cells.description: Sum of offsets around a loop, modulo RelationModulus.
cells.evidence: Loop reads exact 2,176 of 2,176 inside the store; merged and subtracted stores 1,804 of 1,804. The standalone face: 2,028 of 2,028.

cells.name: Steady-state current direction
cells.description: Sign of the probability current around a loop (Kolmogorov criterion).
cells.evidence: Equal to the sign of the exact steady-state current on 200 of 200 rings; reads 0 on every loop of 30 of 30 reversible networks.

cells.name: Frustration: loop parity
cells.description: Parity of the integer sum around a loop.
cells.evidence: Every loop's frustration read is exact.

lid.name: The Read-Time Choice
lid.description: One operation that is not superposable by nature: a choice made at read time from the stored data.

cell.name: Draw one value with probability count / total
cell.description: One exact integer draw that lands on its cumulative count.
cell.evidence: Every draw in [0, total) lands on its value; shares are uniform on four of four views.
